description: For an elementary substructure, every existential formula true in the ambient structure at its parameters has an ambient witness inside that substructure.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ElementarySubmodels.elementary_witnesses.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  [L.Structure M] (S : L.Substructure M) (hS : S.IsElementary) (n : ℕ) (φ : L.BoundedFormula Empty (n + 1))
  (a : Fin n → ↥S) (b : M) (hb : φ.Realize default (Fin.snoc (Subtype.val ∘ a) b)) :
  ∃ c, φ.Realize default (Fin.snoc (Subtype.val ∘ a) ↑c)
